description: Runs the same check as `agent-roast hook run` for plugin hooks of type mcp_tool and answers with the hook's JSON: it sends an agent back once when its changes weaken checks. Meant to be called by a hook, not by hand.

cwd.description: A directory inside the project. Defaults to the project the server was started in.

loop_count.description: How many times the agent was already sent back, for agents that count.

stop_hook_active.description: "true" when the agent is already continuing because of a Stop hook.

name: stop_hook
title: Stop hook adapter
